scope: The full standard simple-root intertwining operator for the spherical SL(2,R) rank-one reduction and its complete even K_alpha-type spectrum; higher-rank K multiplicity spaces are controlled by induction in stages rather than claimed to be scalar.

rank_one_operator.common_algebraic_core: span of e_(2n)(theta)=exp(2 i n theta), n in Z
rank_one_operator.raw_standard_integral: (J_z f)(g)=integral_R f(g w_alpha n(x)) dx for Re(z)>0
rank_one_operator.meromorphic_continuation: the K-finite Fourier coefficients continue meromorphically to every z

complete_even_spectrum.weyl_phase: the (-1)^|n| factor from the Weyl representative makes R_0 the identity on every even K_alpha-type

literature_context.rank_one_reference: Bill Casselman, Representations of SL(2,R), sections 11-14
literature_context.general_reference: A.W. Knapp and E.M. Stein, Intertwining Operators for Semisimple Groups II, Invent. Math. 60 (1980), 9-84
literature_context.use: the formulas are rederived by the compact-picture Fourier integral and recurrence; the references fix the standard normalization and higher-rank induction context

claim_ceiling: Every simple split root has a full meromorphic rank-one standard operator on the even K_alpha-finite core with the displayed complete spectrum. This does not say an arbitrary irreducible Spin(7)xSpin(7) K-type is one-dimensional or that the operator is physical.
